in_sanskrit.name: Mhod
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mhod एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mhod is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'manas' which means mind. This name signifies the one who is the lord of the mind or the master of one's thoughts. It is a spiritual name with deep significance in Hindu mythology.
